_comment: Carry from R9-RO-4 into R9-RO-8 (#1921). No live roster group on main covers #1921; the r9 roster lives on its handoff branch. Shape: .claude/rules/finding-propagation.md.

carries.from: R9-RO-4 put dev/archive/ and dev/audit/ on tests/closure.py's INERT list when it created those directories
carries.control: A file under an INERT prefix that a gate script reads is the skip that leaves main red: tests/closure.py's _is_header_corpus takes tools/audit/round*/D*/*.py out of the tools/audit/ claim because tests/harness_headers.py opens them. dev/audit/ holds only the merged README and the RCA documents after this move, and neither is a round harness. The perturbation: move one live-header harness under dev/audit/ without extending _is_header_corpus and python3 tests/closure.py's inert-and-recorded check goes red, or, if the read is not yet in a closure, orphan classification stays green while select skips the harness.
carries.remeasure: At your merge base, read tests/closure.py's INERT tuple and _is_header_corpus. If dev/audit/ is still a bare prefix, extend the header carve-out in the same commit that moves a round harness under it, and show the inert-and-recorded check red on a planted harness path before the carve-out and green after.
carries.brief: dev/audit/ is INERT. A live harness moved there is unread until _is_header_corpus (or INERT_EXCEPT) names it. Do that in the move commit, not after.

carries.from: R9-RCA-1990 (#1990): R9-RO-6 and R9-RO-5 moved app_approve.sh, preflight.sh, app_comment.sh and the delivery rows, and five seat instruments kept the old paths
carries.control: tools/audit/seat/merge_train.py ran tools/audit/app_approve.sh after the move, so every carry printed `No such file or directory` and the train stopped, while its self-test, whose stub answers any argv containing a script's basename, stayed `43 checks, 0 failed`. Its self-test now reads the real tree: with TOOLS restored to the old paths alone and ROW_DIR to docs/delivery it prints `3 failed`, and with a bare `"bash", "tools/..."` argv it prints `1 failed` naming the path. The other seat scripts' self-tests stub their callees and do not see a missing path; bus.sh's poster pin is the exception (`grep -qxF` on its default line).
carries.remeasure: At your merge base, list every repo-relative script path the seat instruments invoke (`grep -no 'tools/[A-Za-z0-9_./-]*\.\(sh\|py\|mjs\)' tools/audit/seat/*`) and test each with `test -e`. A path your move empties must be re-pointed in the same commit; run `python3 tools/audit/seat/merge_train.py --self-test` and `bash tools/audit/seat/bus.sh --self-test` after the move and show 0 failed.
carries.brief: A move re-points every seat instrument that invokes the moved path, in the move commit. merge_train.py resolves its scripts through its TOOLS table (old path first, then new) and ROW_DIR: a move edits those entries, and retiring an old lookup deletes only the old half of each tuple.
